eddf_metar.notes: Types 3 and 4 retain routine and additional METARs, including half-hour reports. Missing direction includes VRB; missing gust means no gust reported, not zero.

eddf_taf.notes: IEM returned no EDDF TAF records for the requested archive. Empty parquet preserves the returned schema; it is not training data. Live NOAA TAF is saved separately.

openmeteo_previous_runs.notes: Day 0 is a stitched series of short forecast leads, not a fixed archived issuance. Offsets denote 24/48/72 hours before valid time, not explicit run initialization timestamps. Evaluation adds a six-hour publication lag. Early archive offsets can be null; inspect non-null coverage before backtesting.

openmeteo_historical_forecast.notes: Day 0 is a stitched series of short forecast leads, not a fixed archived issuance.

dwd_01420_wind_hourly.notes: Original source columns and quality codes retained. F/FF_10 is m/s; D/DD_10 is degrees true. Recent wins on historical/recent overlap. Missing sentinel -999 is null. These products contain mean wind, not gusts.

dwd_01420_wind_10min.notes: Original source columns and quality codes retained. F/FF_10 is m/s; D/DD_10 is degrees true. Recent wins on historical/recent overlap. Missing sentinel -999 is null. These products contain mean wind, not gusts.

live_forecast.notes: 72 hourly values from the current UTC hour; retrieval timestamp retained.

live_metar.notes: Latest report available at the snapshot hour; raw report retained.

live_taf.notes: Latest report available at the snapshot hour; raw report retained.
